tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included. This is reinforced by the most recent recorded decision on transport, which is to use https everywhere with no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
